Example bulk RNAseq counts matrix

demo_counts.Rd

A gene x sample counts matrix as generated by nf-core/rnaseq with star_rsem

Usage

demo_counts

Format

A data frame with 12 columns/samples and 78,317 rows/genes/features:

Source

Generated in data-raw/demo_counts.R.

Details

Used for demo purposes of '_targets_bulkRNA_DEseq2.R' demo pipeline for bulk RNAseq analysis. Generated using code in: data-raw/demo_counts.R.

Examples
